svg.title: Nous
svg.desc: Provenance. The favicon form of assets/icon-source/nous-mark.svg: the capital N of Archivo Bold (Archivo v2.001, wght 700, wdth 100, https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/archivo/v25/k3k6o8UDI-1M0wlSV9XAw6lQkqWY8Q82sJaRE-NWIDdgffTT0zRp8A.ttf; SIL Open Font License 1.1, The Archivo Project Authors), outlined with fontTools 4.68.0, #eef2f3 on #12304f. For 16 to 48 px the plate corner is 112 (22%, the master's 96 scaled up so the corner still reads) and the N carries a 30-unit stroke of its own colour, a little heavier so it holds at 16 px (checked at 16, 32 and 48 px). No generated imagery.
